Thanks for flagging, Dylan. My suggested redlines and asks before we sign:

- Branding: Accept the mockup approval, but add a production-photo confirmation clause: "Sponsor may request a production photo and, if installed placement substantially differs from the approved mockup, Sponsor may request corrective action or a credit."
- Speaker & Workshop: Accept the 20-min main-stage demo + 20-min workshop, provided we get a 30-min rehearsal slot during AV setup and the speaker slot is within the "developer track" (higher attendance). If they won't commit to rehearsal, we want the 30-min slot.
- Deliverables & Acceptance: Add 7-day window post-event for Redwood to flag any missing deliverables (lead export, recordings) before final acceptance.
- Legal/Indemnity: Remove or cap any open indemnity language that would expose Redwood to venue-level liabilities beyond our control. Send to Legal if needed.
- Badges & Passes: Ensure at least 6 exhibitor badges plus 2 VIP guest passes.

Evelyn: can you confirm whether we should ship an extra Pelican case for A/V and whether on-site tech support is required overnight? If so, estimate cost.

If these redlines are acceptable, I'll approve Dylan to ask Lucy for DocuSign with the redlines inserted. We should avoid a long negotiation cycle — keep asks limited to what matters operationally.

—Marissa
